title: Add app notes editing view tests
description: Add CookbookApp tests for notes section visibility, edit affordance placement, empty-state toolbar access, and save-path invocation from the notes editor flow.
acceptance_criteria: Tests verify that non-empty notes show the Notes section with an edit pencil.
Tests verify that empty notes hide the Notes section and expose an `Edit notes` toolbar action.
Tests verify that saving from the editor sheet invokes the document write path with updated notes content.
Tests are scoped to view structure and editing flow, not markdown rendering internals already covered in CookbookCore.

handoff_summary.completed: All 17 tests written and compile cleanly: notes section visibility (4 tests), edit affordance placement (2 tests), toolbar action visibility (2 tests), EditNotesSheet instantiation (2 tests), save callback invocation (3 tests), document write path (4 tests).
handoff_summary.risks: Tests exercise the notesLines predicate inline rather than via the live view — if ShoppingListDetailView changes its filtering logic the tests will not automatically fail. Low risk given the logic is simple.
handoff_summary.next_action: Run tester agent to execute the test suite and verify all 17 tests pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file overlap with sibling beads expected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Suite/@Test/#expect) consistent with all other CookbookAppTests. notesLines predicate is mirrored inline (not imported) since ShoppingListDetailView is a SwiftUI view without a dedicated testable model; this is the same pattern used in other view tests in the suite. Save-path tests validate the callback protocol and document mutation directly rather than through the full view stack — appropriate scope given the acceptance criteria exclude markdown rendering internals.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: 17 tests: 4 visibility, 2 edit affordance, 2 toolbar visibility, 2 sheet instantiation, 3 save callback, 4 document write path including round-trip.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Tests do not exercise the live SwiftUI toolbar rendering path (no ViewInspector available in the project). Toolbar action visibility is validated via the boolean predicate (doc.notes.isEmpty) that guards it in ShoppingListDetailView.

conflict_risks: No file overlap with sibling beads expected.

execution_history.summary: CookbookAppTests/EditNotesFlowTests.swift contains 17 Swift Testing tests covering all four acceptance criteria. Build-for-testing completes without errors after xcodegen regeneration.
